Hindu Student Abducted and Assaulted in Bangladesh

A Hindu law student and temple priest, Subhash Deuri, was allegedly abducted and assaulted in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He was subjected to torture and forced to arrange ransom payments before being found unconscious and hospitalized. Authorities are investigating the incident.
